verdict.rationale: Auth0 offers 'Private Cloud' dedicated/isolated managed deployments on AWS/Azure for data-residency needs, and supports custom database connections so customer user data can remain in an external store while Auth0 authenticates against it. However, this is still a vendor-managed service, not a self-hosted/on-premises deployment option, so the 'self-managed deployment' part of the story is unmet. Missing for 10: evidence of a true self-hosted/on-prem Auth0 deployment option, and clearer detail on data residency/control guarantees for Private Cloud vs full customer control.
